source.content: @isTest private class AssuranceMissingDeterministicSurfacesMetadataTest { @isTest static void rows() { Metadata.DeployCallbackContext callbackContext = new Metadata.DeployCallbackContext(); Metadata.DeployDetails details = new Metadata.DeployDetails(); Metadata.DeployMessage message = new Metadata.DeployMessage(); Metadata.Operations operations = new Metadata.Operations(); Metadata.CustomField customField = new Metadata.CustomField(); customField.fullName = 'Invoice__c.Paid__c'; System.assertNotEquals(null, callbackContext); System.assertNotEquals(null, details); System.assertNotEquals(null, message); System.assertNotEquals(null, operations); System.assertNotEquals(null, customField); } }

salesforceExclusionReason: Salesforce API 67 rejects Metadata.DeployCallbackContext, Metadata.DeployDetails, Metadata.DeployMessage, Metadata.Operations, and Metadata.CustomField in Apex; retain deterministic local proof and make no Salesforce compile or runtime claim.
